notes: Quality tiers used to decide which model may replace another when a subscription runs out: 3 flagship, 2 strong, 1 light, 0 unknown.
Rules run top to bottom on the lowercase model id and the first match wins. A name fragment must be delimited by - _ / . or space, so 'mini' does not match 'gemini'.
Rules are by naming convention, not measured quality. When unsure, a model is placed LOWER: a replacement is then only rarely chosen, never wrongly trusted.
Unknown models (tier 0) are used as replacements only when the user listed them in the provider pool.
baseline is the tier assumed for the model that is being replaced when its name is not known yet (the CLI default). It is deliberately high: an unknown model is not swapped for a weaker one.
